column8: classic: faithful port of the xscreensaver original. enhanced: same hack with anti-aliasing, soft lighting, glow and smooth palettes. auto: enhanced on GPUs that can afford it, classic otherwise.
Time scale of the animation. 1 matches the original xscreensaver pace.
Seed for the random choices (0 = new every launch). The same seed repeats the same run.
Size of the grid; larger means a bigger field with more room between the wells (xscreensaver -resolution).
Spacing between grid lines; larger means fewer lines (xscreensaver -grid-size).
Line colors by depth. classic is the original green to red. cycle cross-fades between the palettes every 45 seconds.
Distance fog density as a multiple of the original (xscreensaver uses 1). -1 = automatic: none for classic (the look this catalog has always shown), half for enhanced.
Strength of the soft glow around bright areas (enhanced style only). 0 turns the glow pass off.
